facts.value: Each call assigns the requested motion and performs flag-controlled cleanup before selecting the common or character-specific descriptor. It initializes animation timing from the supplied speed and start frame. FreezeState zeroes frame_speed_mul and the local playback speed only when the selected animation ID is not -1. Animation loading, command processing, blending, and grounded animation-derived velocity remain conditional. An eventual animation ID of -1 clears animation flags, animation skeleton state, script pointer, and blend/frame fields. Entry replaces anim/input/phys/coll/cam callbacks and clears the explicitly listed transient callbacks, including accessory1_cb and accessory4_cb; accessory2_cb and accessory3_cb are not cleared here.

facts.value: Allocates a Fighter GObj, Fighter state, and attribute backup; attaches Fighter state with Fighter_Unload_8006DABC as destructor; forwards input->internal_id to character loading and the descriptor to Fighter_UnkInitLoad_80068914. Finally ftLib_800867E8 calls Fighter_ResetInputData_80068854 and sets x221D_b4 true, after which the GObj is returned.

facts.value: After process installation and Fighter_UnkProcessDeath_80068354, startup dispatch tests FTKIND_MASTERH, then FTKIND_CREZYH, then input->has_transformation, then Player_GetFlagsBit3(fp->player_id). These select ftMh_MS_341_8014FE10, ftCh_Init_80155FCC, ftCo_800BFD04, and ftCo_800C61B0 respectively. Otherwise it calls ftCommon_8007D92C only when no_normal_motion is false and reports an assertion when that invariant fails. On the returning path, ftLib_800867E8 then resets input and sets x221D_b4 true before the GObj is returned.
